summary: Enbridge Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a US$2.1 billion three-tranche senior note offering: US$700M 5.450% notes due 2032, US$800M 5.850% notes due 2036, and US$600M 6.350% notes due 2056, fully and unconditionally guaranteed by Enbridge Energy Partners, L.P. and Spectra Energy Partners, LP. Public offering prices were 99.922%, 99.716% and 99.588%, respectively, with underwriting discounts of 0.600%, 0.650% and 0.875%. Notes are unsecured, unsubordinated obligations ranking pari passu with existing senior debt, redeemable at the issuer's option, settling November 13, 2026. This is a routine investment-grade debt takedown, not a special situation.
